# PLOS source data and publication notes

Numerical values underlying the editor-requested figure panels are in
**S1_Data.xlsx** (generated by `scripts/export_s1_data.py`).

Sheet names follow the **published manuscript panel letters** (submitted PDFs).
Some repository folders use different letters; the mapping is on the workbook
README sheet.

## Rebuild the workbook

```bash
conda activate eye_repo_mac
PYTHONPATH=.venv_pkgs python scripts/export_s1_data.py
```

Requires `xlsxwriter` (listed as a documentation extra). Output:

- `publication/S1_Data.xlsx`
- copy to `~/Desktop/PLOS_tech_rev/S1_Data.xlsx` when that folder is writable

## What is not in S1_Data.xlsx

Text-only statistical results (head–saccade timing, 3.7% corrective events,
10.2% active time, Monte Carlo tests) are documented in
[TEXT_ONLY_STATISTICS.md](TEXT_ONLY_STATISTICS.md). Those analyses are
covered by code availability, not by additional worksheets.

## Recovered supplementary tables

`publication/recovered/` holds S2, S4, and S5 tables located in the lab
`Paper_Figures` archive / `revisions_messy` notebooks. Copies also live under
`src/eye_tracking_system_tools/figures/reproduction/supplementary/S2|S4|S5/`.

## Validation

See [VALIDATION_REPORT.txt](VALIDATION_REPORT.txt) for n / median / test
statistics checked against the manuscript while building the workbook.
